title: Majority of Americans support banning social media for kids under 16
summary_en: Across major demographic and partisan groups, more Americans support than oppose banning those under 16 from using social media.

title: 5% of Americans say they’ve ridden in a driverless car
summary_en: Regardless of whether they’ve ridden in one before, most Americans (71%) say they would be not too or not at all comfortable riding in a driverless car.

title: 5 facts about religion in the Philippines

title: Which Americans are most likely to have spoken with a local journalist?
